title: review follow-ups of PR #34708 (plugin dependency cycle refusal): ledger wording, stale door group, step label, resolver note
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: the four nits the contract review of PR #34708 (merged; Fixes #34574) left as follow-ups, comment 6943259717. Dedupe: `PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE` docs/nits; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p3 · domain:server · documentation

## Items

- N1 — the ledger comment says "two or more of whose packages depend on each other"; a package whose `manifest.dependencies` names itself is refused under the same code with `details.cycle` of `['a', 'a']` (pinned in `plugin-order.test.ts`). Reword to "one or more".
- N2 — the new row sits in the group headed "The nine rows below are `door: 'none'` codes … none reaches an HTTP door on this tree", while the sibling paragraph above still records install-local answering with `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` (stale on main since #34407 and #34432). Refresh the group count and the sibling door reading in one pass.
- N3 — `declaredRefusalAnswer`'s docblock and the new test's title call the unrunnable-code step "1c"; in the handler it is `1d` (`1c` is the ADR-0087 protocol handshake).
- N4 — `details.cycle` reaches the wire only because `declaredRefusalAnswer` reads `err.details` itself; the shared `resolveThrownHttpError` does not read a thrown `details`. Record this on the resolver for whoever adds a door that answers this refusal through it (no such door today).

No behaviour change; text and docblocks only.
